text: Chapter 12: The Weredragons' Vital Point@Ark Repair
■Next Mission\nMove from Draco Town to\nDraco Town: Leader's House to start.
You have received Leader Atu's permission to repair the ark,\nbut various components are required to fix it.\nGo collect the components!
The monster that has the component required to fix the ark\nseems to be at the summit of Jabali Kubwa.\nHead to the summit to find it!
You finally found Walican!\nDefeat it to obtain the vital component!
Go to the Wind Ark to deliver the components you have\ncollected!
